Title: WHAT REMOTE WORK CHANGED
Detail_lesson: Hybrid and remote working rearranged how teams talk, share and bond — some of it for the better.
CustomInstruction: Name one thing that got worse and one thing that got better. Be concrete: a meeting that stopped happening, a conversation that now never starts.

Title: OUR GREATEST STRENGTH
Detail_lesson: Every team is unusually good at something, and it is rarely the thing on the org chart.
CustomInstruction: Name the strength and the moment you last saw it hold under pressure. One sentence for each.

Title: THE PROCESS THAT NEEDS FIXING
Detail_lesson: Friction hides in handoffs, approvals and the tools nobody chose on purpose.
CustomInstruction: Name the process and the exact step where it stalls. Then give the smallest change that would unblock that one step.

Title: THE TOOL THAT CHANGED HOW WE WORK
Detail_lesson: Some tools save minutes; a few change what work is possible at all.
CustomInstruction: Name one tool and the task you no longer do because of it. If nothing stopped, the tool did not change much.

Title: THE LESSON THAT STUCK
Detail_lesson: The leadership lessons that last usually arrive attached to something that went badly.
CustomInstruction: Tell it as a story in three sentences: the situation, what you did, what you would do now. Specifics travel; principles do not.
